name: Sala Summer Blind 2018

venue.name: [The Pentecostal Church of Sala](http://www.sala.pingst.se)
venue.details: All events will take place in the church café.

information: Welcome to the first WCA competition in the city of Sala! This will be a slightly smaller than normal, blind-focused, one day competiton. A competitors limit for this event has been set to 40, due to venue constraints. The entry fee of 100 SEK for competitors must be paid in advance for the registration to be valid. Entry is free for spectators and guests. More information about Sala Summer Blind, as well as information about registration and payment can be found on the competition website.
